decisions.statement: How far through an artist Alan is, is added up from the releases naming that artist.
An artist naming no release is listed, and adds to no total.
A release reaches its artist whether or not it names that artist's page type.
The totals are over the artists listed rather than over every artist.
A status no collection states is refused before any page is read.
Every artist is listed where no status is asked for.
The rungs counted are the rungs the artists listed reach.
Artists are listed by how long each one runs, longest first.
Nothing here reaches a music provider.

definition: the command listing the artists Alan keeps, what he graded each and how far he is in
